clock: On Windows, Node process.hrtime.bigint and System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch use QueryPerformanceCounter. Raw values are converted to nanoseconds and must align with marker-receipt causality; any origin/order mismatch is DIAGNOSTIC_INCOMPLETE.

buckets.name: COMMON_STARTUP_COST_DOMINANT
buckets.meaning: process start, script entry, native initialization, framed request read, parse/schema, and admission validation

buckets.name: COMMON_ACQUISITION_COST_DOMINANT
buckets.meaning: common checked root acquisition before the first file attempt

buckets.name: MISSING_LEAF_ACQUISITION_COST_DOMINANT
buckets.meaning: checked file-prefix traversal, missing-leaf decision, and mandatory acquisition unwind

buckets.name: SERIALIZATION_COST_DOMINANT
buckets.meaning: error mapping, response construction, canonical serialization, and response write

buckets.name: SETTLEMENT_COST_DOMINANT
buckets.meaning: diagnostic final trace, helper exit, process close, and all three pipe closures

dominance: A bucket is dominant only when it is the unique bucket whose measured duration is greater than 50 percent of T0-T14.
incomplete: DIAGNOSTIC_INCOMPLETE when T0-T14, every T1-T13 helper tick, every external marker receipt, exact T8/T10 counters, QPC alignment, or monotonic/order checks are unavailable or invalid. A product timeout with complete evidence is classified normally. The exact helper lease deadline from the supervisor start event is paired from performance.now to QPC with measured pairing uncertainty; if the flushed T13 marker may cross it, the result is incomplete as instrumentation contamination.
